scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tax-platform/shared build && pnpm --filter @tax-platform/rules build && pnpm --filter @tax-platform/api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @tax-platform/api build && pnpm --filter @tax-platform/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @tax-platform/shared build && pnpm --filter @tax-platform/rules build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'pnpm --filter @tax-platform/api exec prisma migrate dev && pnpm --filter @tax-platform/api exec prisma generate'
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @tax-platform/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:push: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'pnpm --filter @tax-platform/api exec prisma db push && pnpm --filter @tax-platform/api exec prisma generate'
